purpose: Predeclared DEAP-only diagnostic before returning to joint three-dataset training
original_paper_objective: Train one model jointly on DEAP, GAMEEMO, and SEED-IV, then assess that same model separately on each dataset
comparison_claim: Reference-model superiority and overfitting require matched inputs, labels, participant partitions, training budgets, and observed train/validation/test behavior
label_policy: Recovered spreadsheet valence; <5 negative, >5 positive, exactly 5 excluded
electrodes: All 32 named DEAP EEG electrodes in canonical order
preprocessing: Discard first three seconds; retain existing 4..40 Hz zero-phase trial filter; 128 Hz; four-second non-overlapping windows
model: EEGNet-8,2 development control; F1=8,D=2,F2=16; temporal kernels 64/16; pooling 4/8; dropout 0.5; raw EEG logits
normalization: One frozen mean and population standard deviation per electrode, fitted to training windows only
split: Existing seed-42 DEAP participant split, 22 training / 5 validation / 5 test; trial-disjoint
optimizer: Adam, learning rate 0.001, zero weight decay, fixed learning rate
sampling: Equal training class and original trial weights
checkpoint_selection: Maximum validation trial balanced accuracy; ties use lower class-balanced validation trial log loss
early_stopping: Patience on checkpoint improvement; no stopping before epoch 25
trial_aggregation: Mean positive probability across all 15 windows
test_policy: Infer test after selecting final checkpoint, then independently verify reconstruction; do not tune this run using test results
development_reason: Same DEAP held-out cohort was already inspected in earlier development runs
interpretation: Changes architecture, electrodes, representation, normalization, and budget; cannot isolate normalization as the cause of any difference
